subject: Special Operations - Fireworks - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Special Operations - Fireworks - Vancouver Harbour
Barge Fireworks Display in Coal Harbour, Burrard Inlet off the Vancouver Convention Centre in the vicinity of
49 17.483N 123 06.320W from 070430 UTC Nov 2026 to 070445 UTC Nov 2026.
A safety exclusion zone of 350 metres (1150 feet) established around the barge.
Monitoring VHF channel 12.
